metadata.title: AST-Route: An AST-Aware Multi-Objective Query Routing and Cost-Prediction Framework Across Serverless Cloud, Vectorized CPU (C++/Rust), and GPU-Accelerated OLAP Engines — Complete 400-Query Benchmark Corpus, Raw Telemetry, and Reproducibility Package

creators.name: Noiumkar, Preecha
creators.affiliation: Department of Information Technology, Faculty of Informatics, Mahasarakham University, Thailand

metadata.description: Complete open-source benchmark suite, 400-query Master Workload Inventory across 10 analytical SQL suites (Core TPC-H N=75, Official TPC-H Q1-Q22, Official IMDB JOB N=33, Seed S6 N=15, TPC-DS-derived N=30, BIRD-inspired N=20, TPC-DS-Complex N=25, Enterprise-Redset-BI N=25, Official TPC-DS Q1-Q99 across SF=0.02/1/10 GB, Official ClickBench N=43, and Official SSB N=13), raw per-trial hardware/energy telemetry CSV logs across four physical hardware nodes (Node 1 x86_64 + NVIDIA RTX 2050 4.0 GB VRAM across PyTorch CUDA and CuPy v14.2.0, Node 2 22-thread Intel Core Ultra 7 x86_64, Node 3 Apple M1 ARM64, and Node 4 Enterprise Server NVIDIA Tesla T4 15.0 GB GDDR6 VRAM CUDA 13.0), serialized frozen GBDT routing models, and one-command R1-R6 verification harness for Journal of Big Data (SpringerOpen).
